name: Science Atlas
summary: A specimen plate: one object shown whole, then opened up, with scale always visible. For structures, organisms, processes and findings in the natural world.

visual_job.viewer_leaves_able_to: Picture the structure or process at its real scale and name its parts.
visual_job.hero: One specimen shown whole, then cut away, with a live scale reference.

use_when: The subject has physical structure, scale or a process over time.
A study's finding is the payoff.
Orders of magnitude are part of the surprise.
avoid_when: The subject is man-made software or infrastructure (use systems-blueprint).
The finding is only a number (use data-ledger).

alternates.when: The brief asks for a dark, spatial or cross-section look.
Depth, night or space scale journeys (ocean-descent-documentary).

scene_grammar.formula: The object whole, with a scale bar from frame 1.
Zoom or compare through orders of magnitude, always with a unit bar.
Open the object: cross-section with labelled parts.
One variable changes over time; arrows carry the direction.
The finding as a before/after or chart, with sample size and uncertainty.
What the result does not show.
Back to the whole specimen at the starting scale, with the one-sentence finding.

motion.signature: Scale is always visible; objects are opened, not swapped.
motion.continuous_layer: Slow push or drift, plus seeded particles that follow the physical process.
avoid: A zoom with no scale reference.
Decorative particles unrelated to the process.
A finding stated without sample size or uncertainty.

rules.ending: Return to the whole specimen at the scale it started, with the one-sentence finding.

anti_patterns.pattern: Narration over a frame that does not change for more than max_beat_gap_sec.
anti_patterns.why: Breaks the anti-laziness rule. motion-qa flagged 41 s of 70 (cloud), 44 s of 92 (fridge), 79 s of 98 (Korea) as static or low-energy. Plan one visual event per 2-3 s from measured onsets and give every scene a drift layer (Studio.space.drift).

anti_patterns.pattern: A zoom or comparison with no scale reference.
anti_patterns.why: Scale is the point of the template; without a unit bar the viewer cannot judge size.
anti_patterns.source: Authored from the design profile and VISION.md; not yet render-tested.

anti_patterns.pattern: A finding without sample size or uncertainty.
anti_patterns.why: VISION.md: clear, accurate explanation is as important as visual craft.

reference_projects.note: Scale by depth, cinematic-dark, 50 s landscape.

open_questions: No light-mode scientific style system exists: sci-viz and cinematic-dark are both dark, so the light default falls back to editorial-light. Build a light 'plate' style and make it the default here.

revisions.change: Initial version. Default is light to follow the workspace rule that dark themes need a brief that asks for them.
